name: Reduce wasmoon published output size while preserving runtime

description: Baseline: package tarball size from npm pack dry-run after build, with heapsort runtime guard and npm test checks
Disable JS sourcemap emission in rolldown; tiny tarball win so far because stale dist/index.js.map still remains in the package
Exclude dist/index.js.map from published files by making package.json files list explicit; large tarball reduction with no runtime code change
Tried enabling rolldown minify at the top level; output size was unchanged, so this appears ineffective for the current build
Tried rebuilding the WASM with -flto in the release emcc flags; it substantially increased glue.wasm size, so discard

Tried removing the unused HEAPU32 runtime export from the emscripten build; local glue.wasm rebuilds became much larger than the checked-in artifact, so wasm rebuild experiments are not comparable enough for this loop

name: Reduce wasmoon published output size while preserving runtime (post-wasm-rebuild baseline)

description: Rebased baseline after local wasm rebuild changed the checked-in artifact used by the package-size harness
Trim published declaration set to the files reachable from dist/index.d.ts, dropping unreferenced internal d.ts artifacts from the npm package
Enable TypeScript removeComments so published declaration files drop JSDoc/comment payload without changing runtime behavior
